table.name: warehouse
table.summary: The table represents a warehouse entity with details such as location, size, and contact information.

w_warehouse_id.name: w_warehouse_id
w_warehouse_id.meaning: Unique alphanumeric identifier for the warehouse

w_street_number.name: w_street_number
w_street_number.meaning: Street number of the warehouse address

w_street_name.name: w_street_name
w_street_name.meaning: Street name of the warehouse address

w_suite_number.name: w_suite_number
w_suite_number.meaning: Suite or unit number within the warehouse

w_city.name: w_city
w_city.meaning: City where the warehouse is located

w_county.name: w_county
w_county.meaning: County where the warehouse is located

w_state.name: w_state
w_state.meaning: State where the warehouse is located

w_zip.name: w_zip
w_zip.meaning: Postal code or ZIP code of the warehouse location

w_country.name: w_country
w_country.meaning: Country where the warehouse is located

w_gmt_offset.name: w_gmt_offset
w_gmt_offset.meaning: Time zone offset from Greenwich Mean Time (GMT) for the warehouse location

table.name: promotion
table.summary: The 'promotion' table contains information about various promotional activities, including identifiers, dates, associated items, costs, and channels used for promotion.

p_promo_sk.name: p_promo_sk
p_promo_sk.meaning: Unique identifier for the promotion record.

p_promo_id.name: p_promo_id
p_promo_id.meaning: A unique alphanumeric identifier for the promotion.

p_start_date_sk.name: p_start_date_sk
p_start_date_sk.meaning: Surrogate key representing the start date of the promotion.

p_end_date_sk.name: p_end_date_sk
p_end_date_sk.meaning: Surrogate key representing the end date of the promotion.

p_item_sk.name: p_item_sk
p_item_sk.meaning: Surrogate key representing the item associated with the promotion.

p_cost.name: p_cost
p_cost.meaning: The cost associated with the promotion.

p_response_target.name: p_response_target
p_response_target.meaning: A flag indicating the response target for the promotion.

p_promo_name.name: p_promo_name
p_promo_name.meaning: A short name or code for the promotion.

p_channel_dmail.name: p_channel_dmail
p_channel_dmail.meaning: Indicates whether the promotion is delivered via direct mail.

p_channel_email.name: p_channel_email
p_channel_email.meaning: Indicates whether the promotion is delivered via email.

p_channel_catalog.name: p_channel_catalog
p_channel_catalog.meaning: Indicates whether the promotion is delivered via catalog.

p_channel_tv.name: p_channel_tv
p_channel_tv.meaning: Indicates whether the promotion is delivered via television.

p_channel_radio.name: p_channel_radio
p_channel_radio.meaning: Indicates whether the promotion is delivered via radio.

p_channel_press.name: p_channel_press
p_channel_press.meaning: Indicates whether the promotion is delivered via press.

p_channel_event.name: p_channel_event
p_channel_event.meaning: Indicates whether the promotion is delivered via event.

p_channel_demo.name: p_channel_demo
p_channel_demo.meaning: Indicates whether the promotion is delivered via demo.

p_channel_details.name: p_channel_details
p_channel_details.meaning: Additional details about the promotion channels.

p_purpose.name: p_purpose
p_purpose.meaning: A short code indicating the purpose of the promotion.

p_discount_active.name: p_discount_active
p_discount_active.meaning: Indicates whether the promotion is currently active as a discount.

ca_suite_number.name: ca_suite_number

ca_city.name: ca_city

ca_county.name: ca_county

table.name: catalog_sales
table.summary: The 'catalog_sales' table represents sales transactions related to catalog items. It contains details about the sale, including dates, customer information, item details, pricing, and other transaction-related metrics.

cs_sold_date_sk.name: cs_sold_date_sk
cs_sold_date_sk.meaning: A surrogate key representing the date of the sale.

cs_sold_time_sk.name: cs_sold_time_sk
cs_sold_time_sk.meaning: A surrogate key representing the time of the sale.

cs_ship_date_sk.name: cs_ship_date_sk
cs_ship_date_sk.meaning: A surrogate key representing the date the item was shipped.

cs_bill_customer_sk.name: cs_bill_customer_sk
cs_bill_customer_sk.meaning: A surrogate key representing the customer who billed for the sale.

cs_bill_cdemo_sk.name: cs_bill_cdemo_sk
cs_bill_cdemo_sk.meaning: A surrogate key representing the customer demographic information for the bill.

cs_bill_hdemo_sk.name: cs_bill_hdemo_sk
cs_bill_hdemo_sk.meaning: A surrogate key representing the household demographic information for the bill.

cs_bill_addr_sk.name: cs_bill_addr_sk
cs_bill_addr_sk.meaning: A surrogate key representing the billing address for the sale.

cs_ship_customer_sk.name: cs_ship_customer_sk
cs_ship_customer_sk.meaning: A surrogate key representing the customer who received the shipment.

cs_ship_cdemo_sk.name: cs_ship_cdemo_sk
cs_ship_cdemo_sk.meaning: A surrogate key representing the customer demographic information for the shipment.

cs_ship_hdemo_sk.name: cs_ship_hdemo_sk
cs_ship_hdemo_sk.meaning: A surrogate key representing the household demographic information for the shipment.

cs_ship_addr_sk.name: cs_ship_addr_sk
cs_ship_addr_sk.meaning: A surrogate key representing the shipping address for the sale.

cs_call_center_sk.name: cs_call_center_sk
cs_call_center_sk.meaning: A surrogate key representing the call center involved in the sale.

cs_catalog_page_sk.name: cs_catalog_page_sk
cs_catalog_page_sk.meaning: A surrogate key representing the catalog page where the sale originated.

cs_ship_mode_sk.name: cs_ship_mode_sk
cs_ship_mode_sk.meaning: A surrogate key representing the shipping mode used for the sale.

cs_warehouse_sk.name: cs_warehouse_sk
cs_warehouse_sk.meaning: A surrogate key representing the warehouse involved in the sale.

cs_item_sk.name: cs_item_sk
cs_item_sk.meaning: A surrogate key representing the item sold.

cs_promo_sk.name: cs_promo_sk
cs_promo_sk.meaning: A surrogate key representing the promotion applied to the sale.

cs_order_number.name: cs_order_number
cs_order_number.meaning: The unique order number for the sale.

cs_quantity.name: cs_quantity
cs_quantity.meaning: The quantity of the item sold.

cs_wholesale_cost.name: cs_wholesale_cost
cs_wholesale_cost.meaning: The wholesale cost of the item.

cs_list_price.name: cs_list_price
cs_list_price.meaning: The listed price of the item before any discounts.

cs_sales_price.name: cs_sales_price
cs_sales_price.meaning: The final sales price of the item after discounts.

cs_ext_discount_amt.name: cs_ext_discount_amt
cs_ext_discount_amt.meaning: The total discount amount applied to the sale.

cs_ext_sales_price.name: cs_ext_sales_price
cs_ext_sales_price.meaning: The total sales price of the item after discounts.

cs_ext_wholesale_cost.name: cs_ext_wholesale_cost
cs_ext_wholesale_cost.meaning: The total wholesale cost of the item.

cs_ext_list_price.name: cs_ext_list_price
cs_ext_list_price.meaning: The total list price of the item before any discounts.

cs_ext_tax.name: cs_ext_tax
cs_ext_tax.meaning: The total tax amount applied to the sale.

cs_coupon_amt.name: cs_coupon_amt
cs_coupon_amt.meaning: The total coupon value applied to the sale.

cs_ext_ship_cost.name: cs_ext_ship_cost
cs_ext_ship_cost.meaning: The total shipping cost for the sale.

cs_net_paid.name: cs_net_paid
cs_net_paid.meaning: The net amount paid by the customer for the sale.

cs_net_paid_inc_tax.name: cs_net_paid_inc_tax
cs_net_paid_inc_tax.meaning: The net amount paid by the customer including tax.

cs_net_paid_inc_ship.name: cs_net_paid_inc_ship
cs_net_paid_inc_ship.meaning: The net amount paid by the customer including shipping.

cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax.name: cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax
cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax.meaning: The net amount paid by the customer including both shipping and tax.
cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax.business_concept: Net Paid Including Shipping and Tax

cs_net_profit.name: cs_net_profit
cs_net_profit.meaning: The net profit from the sale.
